grok bot onboarding is painful, so i fixed it @bot 

bot Handoff takes my context 
→ maps the workflow 
→ builds the system 
→ picks the #1 urgent task 
→ spins up bots to get tasks done 

claude code, codex, CLIs context all in the loop.

Try it now
